title: Bondsmith — Molecule Lab
description: Sketch a molecule in 2D, watch it fold into 3D under a VSEPR force field, read its chemistry, export a real .mol file.
concept: A pocket chemistry bench. The left pane is a proper skeletal-formula sketcher — carbons are bare vertices, heteroatoms carry their implicit hydrogens, bonds snap to 30° and cycle single/double/triple on click. Everything you draw is immediately rebuilt in 3D and minimised by a distance-geometry force field that derives its targets from VSEPR steric numbers, ring size, sp2 planarity and conjugation, so methane lands at 109.5°, benzene and caffeine relax flat, and cyclohexane puckers into a chair on its own. The report panel computes formula in Hill order, molecular weight, rings, unsaturation and per-atom geometry, and the export row writes a real MDL V2000 molfile with 3D coordinates that opens in Avogadro, PyMOL or RDKit.
features: Skeletal-formula sketcher: four tools (draw, swap element, move, erase), 10 elements, 30° bond snapping, click-to-cycle bond order
Live VSEPR force field: bond, 1-3 angle, ring-size, sp2 planarity, conjugated-torsion and van der Waals terms minimised in the browser
Three render styles (ball-and-stick, space-fill, wireframe) with orbit, pinch-zoom, auto-spin and per-atom hover readout
Chemistry report: Hill formula, molecular weight, ring count, degrees of unsaturation, mean bond length per bond type, per-atom bond lengths and angles
12 presets from water to caffeine, aspirin and glucose, built from a fused-ring layout engine
Export: MDL .mol with 3D coordinates, 1280×900 PNG, shareable URL hash, and a named molecule library in localStorage

interaction.mouse: Drag from an atom to grow a bond (snapped to 30°); drag the 3D pane to orbit; wheel to zoom; hover an atom for its element and bond count
interaction.click: Click empty canvas to drop an atom, click a bond to cycle single/double/triple, click an atom to inspect its geometry
interaction.touch: Tap to add, drag to bond, pinch to zoom, and a four-way pane switcher (Tools / Sketch / 3D / Report) on phones
interaction.keyboard: h c n o f p s l b i pick elements · r relax · x shake into a new conformer · space toggles spin · 1/2/3 set bond order · Delete removes the selected atom
